primary_metric: Macro mean recovery@16 over cases after averaging seeds; compared against the recorded skeleton_complete dev cells and the frozen parent-strata v1 dev cells.
split_rule: Identical case IDs and seed schedule as the frozen protocols. This is a development pilot: the forced-backbone and budget-enforcement variants run on the dev split only before being frozen for the test split.
method_definition: Same stratum cycle as skeleton_complete. skeleton_complete_forced additionally fixes every forced edge (whose removal from the allowed supergraph disconnects a required path) and presents it as already fixed. Both new variants enforce the public edge budget in the assembly: later model additions are dropped, in parsed order, while the final union exceeds max_edges. Fixed edges are never dropped.
